hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.zsh) if ! out=$(zsh -n "$f" 2>&1); then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; }
git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM -- '*.zsh' | while read -r f; do out=$(zsh -n "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$f: $out" >&2; exit 2; }; done
